annotations.title: List the tools an integration offers

description:
List the tools an integration offers

Returns the actions an agent can be allowed to perform through this integration, plus the recommended default selection in `recommended`. Only a few integration types are catalogue-backed; the rest have a fixed tool set that cannot be picked from and answer 404 here, with the same status used for an integration that does not exist or belongs to someone else. Note each tool's `access` level before enabling it: `write` and `delete` tools let the agent change or remove data in the connected service. `permitted` says whether the permissions of the integration (GET /integrations/{id}/permissions) allow agents to use the tool; a tool that is not permitted cannot be put into `enabledTools` of an agent or chatbot.

id.description: Identifier of the integration. A non-numeric value is rejected with 400.
